happy-path.description: Normal install-dsh flow: clean install, idempotency, uninstall/reinstall, PATH, smoke start, version output.

efs.description: Planted failure: EFS-encrypted directories (C:\Users\owner) break plain CopyFileEx (ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED 5 / EFS 1314); correct handling copies with decryption.

junction.description: Planted failure: directory junctions/links under the install root are followed by the naive copier, landing files on the wrong target or looping; correct handling resolves links and is loop-safe.

service-password.description: Planted failure: the DSH agent service credential (password with special characters) is rejected by CreateServiceW / sc.exe create (error 1069); correct handling quotes/escapes the credential.
